beats.text: At the edge of the Dandaka forest, the sages welcomed Rama with fruit and flowers. 'Protect us,' they begged. 'Demons hunt us here.'
As they moved deeper into the forest, a terrible demon, Viradha, rose before them. He was as tall as a mountain, with a gaping mouth, wearing a tiger's skin.
He snatched Sita and mocked the princes. 'You wear the clothes of hermits, but carry bows and a woman. I will make her my wife.'
Rama and Lakshmana's arrows flew again and again, but no weapon could stop him. He had a boon from Brahma.
So the brothers wrestled him to the ground.
At last, they buried him alive in a deep pit. Before dying, he revealed he was a cursed celestial named Tumburu, now free.
